title: Sequencer waits forever when the solver agent is unloaded during a solver step or flip centering
description:
Pre-existing. When a solver step (sync_center, precise_goto, set_solver_filter) or the meridian flip centering already waits for the solver's AGENT_START_PROCESS or another property and the solver agent is unloaded, the property deletion does not reach on_update, so the wait never ends and the sequence or flip hangs. This task only re-selects the solver at the start of each step or flip. Next: fail the waiting step when its device or property is deleted, or time out.
